page.layout: One page of text; running head at top; a marginal note at the left margin ("Cap. 28.") beside the first lines; a printed ornament and FINIS below the text.

main_text.p: Cap. 28.nnul vero exitum indignum, quoad mundum, vides. Sic Petrus, Iohan. 21. Sed ita seruos suos sibi conformes facit Christus, 1. Tim. 2. Rom 8. &c.

VIDIMVS hucusque librum hunc. Veteris Ecclesiae formam, fidem & doctrinam continet. Docet item, Ecclesiam in hoc mundo exerceri, sed per Christum defendi fideliffimè, Matth 28. Ioh. 10. In hoc ergo nobis hodie fiendum, qui non deerit.

page.notes: The first word of the first line is printed as "nnul" with a stray letter, read here as "mul" [?]. The text "fideliffimè" and "fiendum" are doubtful and may read "fidendum" [?]. The marginal "Cap. 28." is set in the left margin with an ornamental initial. The ornament below FINIS is a printed woodcut device, not transcribed.
